info.title: AIOps Canvas V3 security domain fragment
info.description: WAN-119 domain contract. WAN-117 merges these paths and schemas into the generated V3 aggregate.

get.description: Requires an active human platform administrator with global workspace.manage and access to one selected environment. With a configured security authority the response is a complete, fresh, scope-bound snapshot with an empty unavailable map and an ETag. Without a configured authority (AIOPS_V3_SECURITY_AUTHORITY_URL) nothing local can prove the effective policy: the response is 200 with every SecurityView field null, unavailable=not_configured for each, and no ETag, so PUT cannot proceed. A persisted request, local default, mock, or incomplete authority snapshot is never returned as an effective policy. A configured authority that fails or returns an invalid snapshot is 503 security_authority_unavailable; an unresolved policy operation is 503 security_reconciliation_required. Authorization and the session are checked first in both cases.

200.description: Complete effective SecurityView at the returned revision (with ETag), or the all-unknown view when no authority is configured (no ETag)

ETag.description: Strong runtime revision tag for If-Match; absent for the all-unknown view

put.summary: Apply and verify editable security controls
put.description: Requires an active human platform administrator with global workspace.manage, one selected environment, and an If-Match revision from GET. Accepts the complete SecurityView; an echoed unavailable map is accepted only when empty. SSO providers, display labels, session idle/max, Vault, token TTL, and password policy are read-only and must equal the current effective snapshot. Editable fields are scim, mfa_policy, mfa_methods enabled flags by stable ID, approval_passkey, session.ip_allow, and session.new_device_notice. Success requires an authority apply receipt and a fresh complete readback proving the new controls are effective, then a durable local ledger and audit commit. An unknown external outcome is never reported as success.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Strong ETag from GET /security; wildcards and weak tags are invalid

200.description: Requested controls applied, read back as effective, and durably recorded

SelectedEnvironment.name: X-AIOps-Environment
SelectedEnvironment.description: One authorized environment; when omitted the instance default is selected by V3 middleware. all is not valid for security policy reads or writes

SecurityViewResponse.description: SecurityView from a valid authority snapshot; every field is proven, so unavailable is empty

SecurityViewInput.description: PUT body: the complete SecurityView; the GET unavailable map may be echoed only when empty

SecurityUnknownView.description: No security authority is configured: every field is null and unavailable gives not_configured for each (merged V3Unavailable reasons)

BadRequest.description: Malformed body, content type, scope, or If-Match tag

Unauthenticated.description: Missing, expired, or revoked Cookie session

Forbidden.description: Human platform administrator or selected-environment authorization missing

Conflict.description: A prior operation remains unresolved, or the authority rejected a concurrent application

PreconditionFailed.description: If-Match does not match the current effective revision

Unprocessable.description: A field is immutable, invalid, or not enforceable by the configured authority

Unavailable.description: The trustworthy authority, complete effective readback, or policy ledger is unavailable
